title: Sprott Physical Gold and Silver Trust Updates Its “At-the-Market” Equity Program
description: TORONTO, April  06, 2023  (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Sprott Asset Management LP ("Sprott Asset Management"), a subsidiary of Sprott Inc., on behalf of the Sprott Physical Gold and Silver Trust (NYSE: CEF) (TSX: CEF) (TSX: CEF.U) (the "Trust"), a closed-ended mutual fund trust created to invest and hold substantially all of its assets in physical gold and silver bullion, today announced that it has updated its at-the-market equity program to issue up to US$250 million of units of the Trust (“Units”) in the United States and Canada.
